spans.s: pāvamāná, a. relating to Agni 🞄Pavamāna or the Soma which is being purified 🞄[] 🞄by a strainer: ī́, f. gnly. pl. Soma hymns 🞄(esp. in RV., maṇḍala IX.)
pavitra-ya, den. P. purify, cleanse: 🞄pp. ita, purified, sanctified, blessed.

pavítra-vat, a. possessed of a 🞄means of purificating, a strainer or blades of 🞄Kuśa grass;
 purifying, cleansing.

pavitra‿āropaṇa, n. investiture 🞄of Kṛṣṇaʼs effigy with the sacred cord, a 🞄certain festival;
 -ārohaṇa, n. id..
pāvak-i, m. son of Fire, Skanda.
pāvara, a die (corrupt form of dvāpara).

pā́vīrav-a, a. (ī) coming from or 🞄relating to the thunderbolt (paviru);
 f. 🞄daughter of lightening, thunder.
